kurz: Too much water, butter that was too warm or too much kneading have built up a [[glutenbildung|gluten network]].
bild_im_kopf: Like tufts of wool being knitted into a jumper: too much kneading weaves together what should stay loose.

ursachen.warum: With more water, more network forms.
fix: Add water a spoonful at a time, just until the pastry holds

ursachen.warum: Soft butter blends in instead of coating the flour in little pieces.
fix: Cold butter, cold hands, chill the pastry in between

q1.frage: Did you knead the pastry properly?

q2.frage: Was the butter soft or the pastry very moist?
